title: Genome-wide analysis of MYB transcription factors in four Rheum L. plants provides new insights into the synthesis of Anthraquinones.
authors: Wang, Tao; Zhao, Shuo; Wang, Bo; Li, Jianan; Ye, Zengrong; Zhang, Famei; Ma, Huiyuan; Zhou, Guoying
one_liner_zh: 该文对四种大黄属植物MYB转录因子进行全基因组鉴定与表达分析，并初步关联蒽醌合成通路，但缺乏蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: R. tanguticum (Rheum tanguticum Maxim. ex Regel) is a herbaceous plant belonging to Polygonaceae family and Rheum L. genus. It holds considerable value in culinary and medicinal realms, primarily due to their rich Anthraquinones (AQs) content. Understanding the molecular mechanisms that regulate AQs biosynthesis is a prerequisite for increasing their yield. MYB transcription factors (TFs) can regulate the synthesis of a variety of plant secondary metabolites. However, only a few research have explored the role of MYB TFs in Rheum L. species. In this study, 1054 MYB genes from four Rheum L. species were identified. The number of MYB genes in each species was similar, distributed across 11 chromosomes. To investigate the phylogeny of identified MYB TFs, they were classified into four subfamilies. Sequence characteristics, phylogenetic relationships, evolutionary trends, and tissue expression of MYB genes in Rheum L. species were further studied. Subsequently, 12 MYB genes were selected, which shown differential expression in different tissues. Further research on these genes indicated a significant correlation with genes in shikimate pathway and polyketide pathway of AQs biosynthesis. Protein-protein interaction simulations in Arabidopsis thaliana and qRT-PCR experiments further confirmed this situation. This research lays the foundation for studying molecular mechanisms by which MYB TFs regulates AQs biosynthesis in four Rheum L. species.
abstract_zh: 掌叶大黄（Rheum tanguticum Maxim. ex Regel）是一种属于蓼科（Polygonaceae）和大黄属（Rheum L.）的草本植物。由于其富含蒽醌类化合物（Anthraquinones, AQs），在烹饪和医药领域具有重要价值。理解调控AQs生物合成的分子机制是提高其产量的前提。MYB转录因子（Transcription Factors, TFs）能够调控多种植物次生代谢物的合成。然而，目前仅有少量研究探讨了MYB TFs在大黄属物种中的作用。本研究从四个大黄属物种中鉴定出1054个MYB基因。每个物种中MYB基因的数量相似，分布在11条染色体上。为探究所鉴定MYB TFs的系统发育关系，将其划分为四个亚家族。进一步研究了大黄属物种中MYB基因的序列特征、系统发育关系、进化趋势及组织表达情况。随后，筛选出12个在不同组织中表现出差异表达的MYB基因。对这些基因的进一步研究表明，它们与AQs生物合成中的莽草酸途径和聚酮途径基因显著相关。在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用模拟及qRT-PCR实验进一步证实了这一情况。本研究为探讨MYB TFs调控四个大黄属物种中AQs生物合成的分子机制奠定了基础。
